data.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80,000 as AI-Related Market Selloff Deepens
data.description: Bitcoin retreated below $80,000 on Monday as broader risk-off sentiment ahead of a Federal Reserve meeting and concerns over the artificial intelligence trade weighed on cryptocurrencies.
